changelog: Virtual TV 2.0 full release. This release promotes the validated 1.10.19 runtime behavior without changing scheduling or playback logic. It retains Standard TV, Personalized TV, weighted True Random, Guide text polish, Content Coverage and the Standard TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning shortcut. Release packaging now includes a Jellyfin repository manifest with the canonical Virtual TV GUID and developer R-BCK-gitgub so Jellyfin can display repository metadata when the manifest is configured as an accessible plugin repository.
